description: Boots an AVD headless (host GPU), as the dashboard does; this server shuts it down again when it stops. quick loads the Quick Boot snapshot, cold boots from scratch. Returns at once: poll status until its state is running and its serial is listed as a ready device (a cold boot takes a minute or more). Device control.
